# Teregon Labs

> Teregon Labs is an applied AI and software studio building useful systems for messy data, real decisions, and a living world.

We build AI workflows, data and decision systems, and focused software for customer operations, knowledge search, forecasting, and nature-led intelligence. Our work is grounded in evidence, human review, and measurable outcomes.

## Selected systems

The site describes BrioBot (evidence-bound support triage), Briopedia (a git-backed knowledge base), BrioScope (support analytics), and Brio Sales Navigator (read-only forecasting and customer analytics). These are prior Brio team product systems, not Teregon client engagements. “From ridge to river” and “Where heat settles” are exploratory Teregon concepts, not completed client projects.
